integrity: Proof is analytic for all integer even orders. Python exact-rational checker verifies finite samples but is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Real quadratic spherical harmonics on the probability-normalized two-sphere; positive even integer exponents, strict ordering from the sixth moment onward; no complex higher-moment or other-degree claims; older equivalent Gaussian moment identities may exist.
title: An all-even-moment shape ordering for real degree-two spherical harmonics
